lines.text: The young man says he has kept them all, so Jesus tells him to sell his possessions.
Jesus promises him treasure in heaven, but the young man goes away in joy because he has great wealth.
Jesus says a camel passing through a needle's eye is easier, and the disciples ask who can be saved.
Peter asks what they will get, and Jesus says they will sit on twelve thrones judging the tribes of Judah.
